item.title: Multi-Modal Fusion Framework for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Prediction
item.description:
Adhikari K, Joshi D, Balasubramanian L, et al. Multi-modal fusion framework for hepatocellular carcinoma prediction using genomic, imaging, and clinical data. International Conference for Genomic Medicine (ICGM), 2026. Poster.

Abstract

This work presents a multi-modal fusion framework that combines genomic data, medical imaging, and clinical attributes to enhance the accuracy of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) diagnosis and prediction. The integrated approach provides a comprehensive view of disease progression and improves diagnostic capabilities.

item.title: Portable DNA Sequencing Technologies Supporting Far-Forward Operations
item.description:
Lar O, Clark J, McArdle J, Adhikari K, Allely E. Portable DNA sequencing technologies supporting far-forward operations: low size, weight, power, and now fidelity align with expeditionary requirements. Military Health System Research Symposium (MHSRS), 2025.

Abstract

This work focuses on portable DNA sequencing technologies suitable for far-forward operations. The approach emphasizes low size, weight, and power (SWaP) requirements while maintaining high fidelity, making it suitable for expeditionary and field deployment scenarios.
